properties.name: NASA public GCOV sample (track 30, frame 19)
properties.why: Public NASA NISAR sample GCOV pair used to validate the HDF5 reader and pipeline end to end on a real product structure. Metadata states missionId=ALOS, instrumentName=PALSAR, radarBand=L (2008 acquisitions in NISAR GCOV format). It is NOT NISAR S-band data and fails the TerraTrace S-band contract by design. AOI = 15 x 15 km box at the grid centre (analyst choice).
